9c2affe0: ;
 ;Logic for determining the status of the TIU Note. The status is one of:
 ;   INCOMPLETE (Note not completely done)
 ;   DICTATED (Note dictated)
 ;   TRANSCRIBED (Note transcribed)
 ;   SIGNED (Note signed by Provider)
 ;   SIGNED NO REVIEW (Note signed by Provider, no review required)
 ;   REVIEWED (Note signed by Provider after review)
 ;
01b13327: ;For supplemental fields: if signed date and reviewed date are null this is an incomplete supplemental note.
28c41a9c: ;For supplemental fields: if signed date null and reviewed date populated, this is a reviewed supplemental note.
7ae4891c: ;For supplemental fields: if signed date populated, reviewed date null, and deletion approved flag is NO, this is a SIGNED NO REVIEW supplemental note.
478a407c: ;For supplemental fields: if signed date populated, reviewed date null, and deletion approved flag is YES, this is a SIGNED supplemental note.
fa5f6172: ;For regular notes: if signed date is null, this is an incomplete note.
e6d6bb86: ;If dictated date is null, this is a dictated note.
5729faec: ;If signed date is null, this is a transcribed note.
b8a32b27: ;If signed date is populated, reviewed date is null, and deletion approved flag is NO, this is a SIGNED NO REVIEW note.
ed1cd8d5: ;If signed date is populated and reviewed date is null, this is a SIGNED note.
39656c88: ;If signed date is populated, reviewed date is populated, and deletion approved flag is YES, this is a REVIEWED note.
d47f47c3: ;Update the STATUS field in the TIU NOTE file (#393) with the determined status.
